newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PSE fall continues, CEZ dominates trading.
newsitem.headline: Czech PSE fall continues, CEZ dominates trading.

text.p: Hard times continue to beset the Prague Stock Exchange on Thursday, as Czech shares closed lower for the sixth consecutive session.
Shares of Komercni Banka and utility CEZ edged higher, but most other major shares lost ground, pushing the PX50 index down 1.1 points, or 0.23 percent, to close at 479.6.
Overall, 341 issues fell on the day, while 280 rose and 148 held steady. Total volume was heavier at 1.18 billion shares on turnover of 1.02 billion crowns.

CEZ, which closed up 15 crowns at 923 after crashing through its previous 12 month low of 935 on Wednesday, dominated trading in direct and block deals, with some 426,400 shares changing hands at prices ranging between 930 and 1,000 crowns.
Savings bank Ceska Sporitelna fell eight crowns, 2.7 percent.
Dealers said they expected the bourse to fall further over the coming days -- it has lost almost 4.5 percent over the declining streak -- though some said it may be nearing a bottom.
